one_liner.zh: 通过 Kiwix ZIM 书库离线搜索并读取百科文章。
one_liner.en: Search and read encyclopedia articles offline from a Kiwix ZIM library.

external_services.purpose: Serves the ZIM catalog, search results, title suggestions, and article content requested by the plugin.

local: A Kiwix-serve HTTP service with ZIM files must be available at the configured baseUrl.

config_items.name: defaultBook
config_items.description: ZIM book or alias used when a tool call omits book.

config_items.name: maxTextChars
config_items.description: Default maximum article text length returned by wiki_read.

config_items.name: catalogTtlMs
config_items.description: Book catalog cache duration in milliseconds.

completeness.reason: Three registered tools cover book discovery, full-text/title search, and article reading; responses have limits and missing-item guidance.

code.reason: The client separates parsing and HTTP work, validates settings, and handles redirects, timeouts, and non-2xx responses.

docs.reason: README and quickstart explain prerequisites, installation, configuration, usage, and deployment examples.

maintenance.reason: The list records seven commits and a first push on 2026-10-05; this is a short history.

tests.reason: One test file is present with offline unit cases and live-server integration cases; CI is not listed.

quality.notes: Conservative assessment from the C-lite source sample and list metadata.
